name: Clown Camp: Christmas Special!
source:
A nice field-trip across the country goes wrong when your entire camp group gets kidnapped by an elf! Now you and your field-trip partner must travel through the winter to save your friends!! 

[From [url=https://tyangerine.itch.io/clown-camp-christmas-special-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一趟原本愉快的横跨全国户外研学之旅突生变故——整个营地小队竟被一名精灵绑架了！如今，你必须与自己的研学搭档携手穿越漫天风雪，把伙伴们统统救出来！！

[摘自[url=https://tyangerine.itch.io/clown-camp-christmas-special-demo]itch.io[/url]]
